title: Crystal Nexus
description: Tetris evolved — element resonance chains, prism surge mode, and rift shards in a cosmic crystal universe.
detailedDescription: Crystal Nexus takes classic Tetris into a new dimension with three unique mechanics. Element Resonance lets same-element blocks chain-react through cleared lines in element-specific patterns (Pyre burns horizontally, Frost freezes vertically, Storm arcs in a cross, Terra quakes diagonally). Prism Surge builds a charge meter from skillful clears — activate it for zero-gravity phasing pieces with 3x scoring. Rift Shards spawn every 60 lines — cover them to trigger massive board-clearing effects. Full guideline spec: SRS wall kicks, 7-bag randomizer, hold piece, 5-next queue, T-spin detection, back-to-back bonus, combo system.
controls: Arrow keys to move/soft drop. Up to rotate CW. Z to rotate CCW. Space to hard drop / activate Prism Surge. C to hold. Shift for 180 spin.

achievements.title: Prism Awakening
